en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a covered walkway with arches and columns, likely a cloister or a courtyard in a historical building. There are two women dressed in early 20th-century European fashion standing under the arches. Large potted plants line the walkway, and the architecture features decorated capitals on the columns and Mediterranean-style roof tiles visible in the background.
